Name: Craftable Auto-Petter
Author: cosplaywrite
Description:
[center][url=https://flic.kr/p/2nBaZHz][img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/52250212199_af659534a8_m.jpg[/img][/url][/center]

Tired of grinding for treasure rooms in the Skull Cavern, hoping it'll yield an auto-petter so you can automate your barns and coops?
Tired of spending 50,000 gold apiece to buy this machine from JoJa after selling your soul to them?
This mod is for you!

Adds a crafting blueprint for the auto-petter. As it turns out, Joja have been ripping off their customers for years, selling auto-petters at a ridiculous markup because they could. Thanks to some totally not corporate espionage, Marnie has unearthed the blueprints for the auto-petter and they're surprisingly simple and cheap to make. So now you get to make as many as your heart desires!

[center][url=https://flic.kr/p/2nB8y1z][img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/52249735497_29f0688849_m.jpg[/img][/url][/center]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]﻿
Stardew Valley 1.6

[b][color=#ff0000]Please note that with the latest update, the mod will no longer work with versions of SDV older than 1.6.[/color][/b]

[center][url=https://flic.kr/p/2nBf1Ns][img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/52250996294_e01396a4cd_m.jpg[/img][/url][/center]

[spoiler]﻿Blueprint is mailed to you by Marnie the day after achieving Farming Level 7.[/spoiler]
